name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'Specify a new version (e.g., 1.2.3). If omitted, the next version will be auto‑detected.'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (e.g., codex, glm, kimi).'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  draft_release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Verify actor
        if: ${{ github.actor != 'dyoshikawa' && github.actor != 'cm-dyoshikawa' }}
        run: |
          echo "❌ This workflow can only be run by dyoshikawa or cm-dyoshikawa."
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Determine new version
        id: determine_version
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" ]; then
            echo "Running release-dry-run to determine next version..."
            NEW_VERSION=$(npx release-dry-run)
            echo "NEW_VERSION=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "Using provided new_version: ${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}"
            echo "NEW_VERSION=${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Resolve model abbreviation
        id: select_model
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}

      - name: Create release branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/v${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}
          git push origin release/v${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          NEW_VERSION: ${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}
        with:
          script: |
            const prTitle = `Release v${process.env.NEW_VERSION}`;
            const prBody = `Automated release PR for v${process.env.NEW_VERSION}.`;
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: prTitle,
              head: `release/v${process.env.NEW_VERSION}`,
              base: 'main',
              body: prBody,
              draft: false
            });
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.number}`);

      - name: Create draft GitHub release
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          NEW_VERSION: ${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}
        with:
          script: |
            const tagName = `release/v${process.env.NEW_VERSION}`;
            const releaseName = `v${process.env.NEW_VERSION}`;
            const { data: release } = await github.rest.repos.createRelease({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              tag_name: tagName,
              name: releaseName,
              draft: true,
              prerelease: false,
              body: `Draft release for v${process.env.NEW_VERSION}.`
            });
            console.log(`Created draft release ${release.html_url}`);
